description: Reference thresholds and metadata for AVD Insights alerts. Each category is a single scheduled-query alert rule that unions all sub-signals; the alert fires when ANY signal in the category breaches its threshold. NOTE: Actual deployed thresholds are defined as 'let' variables in the KQL files under queries/. Edit the KQL files to change thresholds, then re-deploy.

SessionQuality.description: User-experience signals: input delay (per-process and per-session), network round-trip time, and UDP bandwidth.

alerts.name: AVD-Insights-Category-SessionQuality
alerts.description: One or more session-quality signals (InputDelay, RoundTripLatency, UDPBandwidth) breached thresholds.

HostPerformance.description: Resource saturation signals: CPU, memory, page faults, memory commit, and disk timing.

alerts.name: AVD-Insights-Category-HostPerformance
alerts.description: One or more host-performance signals (CPU, Memory, MemoryCommit, Pages, PageFaults-Baseline, DiskTiming) breached thresholds.

DiskHealth.description: Disk queue depth and free space signals.

alerts.name: AVD-Insights-Category-DiskHealth
alerts.description: One or more disk-health signals (DiskQueueLength, DiskFreeSpace) breached thresholds.

SessionLifecycle.description: Sign-in duration, host pool capacity, and session balance signals.

alerts.name: AVD-Insights-Category-SessionLifecycle
alerts.description: One or more session-lifecycle signals (SignInDegradation, CapacityPressure, SessionImbalance) breached thresholds.

CorrelatedSignals.description: Multi-signal correlation alerts combining host performance with session/profile data.

alerts.name: AVD-Insights-Category-CorrelatedSignals
alerts.description: One or more correlated signals (CorrelatedHosts, FSLogixCorrelation) detected multi-dimensional degradation.

EventLogAlerts.description: Windows Event Log signals for FSLogix profile health and system errors.

alerts.name: AVD-Insights-Category-EventLogAlerts
alerts.description: FSLogix profile attach/detach failures or VHD errors detected in operational/admin event logs.

GPUPerformance.description: RemoteFX Graphics encoding and frame delivery signals. Only applicable to GPU-enabled session hosts.

alerts.name: AVD-Insights-Category-GPUPerformance
alerts.description: GPU encoding time exceeds the 33ms RDP frame budget on GPU-enabled session hosts.
